intro: Convert millimeter to inches measurements accurately for fasteners, pipe diameters, and workshop layouts. Since 1 international inch is legally defined as exactly 25.4 mm, dividing millimeters by 25.4 converts mm into inch decimals cleanly (1 mm ≈ 0.03937008 in). Acting as a fast mm to decimal calculator, the tool also displays the nearest 1/16, 1/32, and 1/64 tape-measure fractions alongside our mm to fractional inches conversion chart below.
alsoWrittenAs: millimetres to inches, mm to in, millimeter to inch, mm to decimal inches, mm to fractional inches
tableSubtitle: MM to fractional inches conversion and decimal inch reference table from 1 mm to 300 mm. Click any row to load it into the calculator.
tableRoundingNote: Computed with the exact factor 1 mm = 1 / 25.4 in (≈ 0.03937008 in); decimals rounded to up to 5 decimal places alongside nearest 1/64" and 1/16" fractions.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Exact NIST Factor vs. Early Rounding Drift
items: Always divide millimeters by the exact divisor 25.4 rather than multiplying by a truncated 0.039 factor, which introduces a 0.94% error (nearly 0.08 inches off at 205 mm).
When reading tape-measure fractions, remember that 1/16" increments round to the nearest 1.5875 mm, while 1/64" increments resolve down to ~0.397 mm.

faqs.question: How many inches (in) are in 1 millimeter (mm)?
faqs.answer: There are approximately 0.03937008 inches (in) in 1 millimeter (mm), calculated as 1 ÷ 25.4. Conversely, 1 inch equals exactly 25.4 millimeters.

faqs.question: How do I convert millimeters to inches (mm to in)?
faqs.answer: To convert millimeters to inches, divide the millimeter value by 25.4 (in = mm ÷ 25.4). For example, 12.7 mm ÷ 25.4 equals exactly 0.5 in.

faqs.question: What is 22 mm in inches?
faqs.answer: 22 millimeters (mm) equals 0.86614 inches (in), which is just under 7/8 of an inch (0.875 in) or close to 55/64" on a precision ruler.
